purpose: One-time read-only diagnostic of which account-wide D1/R2 analytics datasets are empty, missing, stale, or capped; capture metrics only when complete.

execution.history_check: One GitHub Actions workflow-runs metadata request; prior or ambiguous V0.2 runs fail closed.
execution.readiness: Separate repeatable zero-network V0.2 workflow must report READY on current main before dispatch.
execution.account_id_source: GitHub Actions Secret CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID; requires nonempty match with CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID Variable before Cloudflare access.

forbidden_operations: Rerun V0.1 or V0.2, retry or paginate Cloudflare requests.
R2 listing, object access, writes, deletes, or S3 credentials.
D1 SQL, migration, provisioning, or writes.
Provider calls, market data, holdout, training, promotion, trading, or schedule activation.
Inferring invoice amount, plan, or every external writer from analytics.
